verses.en: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
verses.pt: Portanto, devemos prestar atenção com muito mais empenho para as coisas que já ouvimos, para que nunca venhamos a cometer deslizes.
verses.en_web: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason there is the more need for us to give attention to the things which have come to our ears, for fear that by chance we might be slipping away.

verses.en: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
verses.pt: Pois, se a palavra pronunciada pelos anjos foi confirmada, e toda transgressão e desobediência recebeu justa retribuição,
verses.en_web: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense;
verses.en_bbe: Because if the word which came through the angels was fixed, and in the past every evil act against God's orders was given its full punishment;

verses.en: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
verses.pt: como nós escaparemos, se descuidarmos de tão grande salvação? Ela, que começou a ser anunciada pelo Senhor, foi-nos confirmada pelos que ouviram.
verses.en_web: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard;
verses.en_bbe: What will come on us, if we do not give our minds to such a great salvation? a salvation of which our fathers first had knowledge through the words of the Lord, and which was made certain to us by those to whom his words came;

verses.en: God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will?
verses.pt: Deus também deu testemunho com eles, por meio de sinais, milagres, várias maravilhas, e distribuições do Espírito Santo, segundo a sua vontade.
verses.en_web: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?
verses.en_bbe: And God was a witness with them, by signs and wonders, and by more than natural powers, and by his distribution of the Holy Spirit at his pleasure.

verses.en: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
verses.pt: Pois não foi aos anjos que ele sujeitou o mundo futuro, do qual estamos falando.
verses.en_web: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.
verses.en_bbe: For he did not make the angels rulers over the world to come, of which I am writing.

verses.en: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.pt: Mas em certo lugar alguém testemunhou, dizendo: O que é o homem, para que te lembres dele? Ou o filho do homem, para que o visites?
verses.en_web: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?
verses.en_bbe: But a certain writer has given his witness, saying, What is man, that you keep him in mind? what is the son of man, that you take him into account?

verses.en: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:
verses.pt: Tu o fizeste um pouco menor que os anjos, de glória e de honra o coroaste, e o estabeleceste sobre as obras das tuas mãos;
verses.en_web: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.
verses.en_bbe: You made him a little lower than the angels; you gave him a crown of glory and honour, and made him ruler over all the works of your hands:

verses.en: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
verses.pt: Sujeitaste todas as coisas debaixo de seus pés.Pois ao lhe sujeitar todas as coisas, nada deixou que não fosse sujeito a ele; porém agora ainda não vemos todas as coisas sendo sujeitas a ele. Salmos 8:4-6
verses.en_web: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t see all things subjected to him, yet.
verses.en_bbe: You put all things under his feet. For in making man the ruler over all things, God did not put anything outside his authority; though we do not see everything under him now.

verses.en: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man.
verses.pt: Porém vemos coroado de glória e de honra, por causa do sofrimento de morte, aquele Jesus, que havia sido feito um pouco menor que os anjos, a fim de que, pela graça de Deus, experimentasse a morte por todos.
verses.en_web: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.
verses.en_bbe: But we see him who was made a little lower than the angels, even Jesus, crowned with glory and honour, because he let himself be put to death so that by the grace of God he might undergo death for all men.

verses.en: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.pt: Pois convinha a aquele, para quem e por quem são todas as coisas, que, quando trouxesse muitos filhos à glória, aperfeiçoasse por meio de aflições o Autor da salvação deles.
verses.en_web: For it became him, for whom are all things, and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.en_bbe: Because it was right for him, for whom and through whom all things have being, in guiding his sons to glory, to make the captain of their salvation complete through pain.

verses.en: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
verses.pt: Porque tanto o que santifica como os que são santificados, todos são provenientes de um; por isso ele não se envergonha de lhes chamar de irmãos,
verses.en_web: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
verses.en_bbe: For he who makes holy and those who are made holy are all of one family; and for this reason it is no shame for him to give them the name of brothers,

verses.en: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.pt: dizendo: Anunciarei o teu nome aos meus irmãos, cantarei louvores a ti no meio da congregação. Salmos 22:22
verses.en_web: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among of the congregation I will sing your praise.”
verses.en_bbe: Saying, I will give the knowledge of your name to my brothers, I will make a song of praise to you before the church.

verses.en: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which God hath given me.
verses.pt: E outra vez: Nele confiarei. Isaías 8:17 E outra vez: Eis-me aqui, com os filhos que Deus me deu. Ref. Isaías 8:18
verses.en_web: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”
verses.en_bbe: And again he says, I will put my faith in him. And again, See, I am here, and the children which God has given to me.

verses.en: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
verses.pt: Portanto, uma vez que os filhos compartilham da carne e do sangue, também ele, semelhantemente, participou das mesmas coisas, a fim de pela morte aniquilar ao que tinha o poder da morte, isto é, o diabo;
verses.en_web: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,
verses.en_bbe: And because the children are flesh and blood, he took a body himself and became like them; so that by his death he might put an end to him who had the power of death, that is to say, the Evil One;

verses.en: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.pt: e libertar a todos os que, por medo da morte, estavam sujeitos à servidão durante a vida toda.
verses.en_web: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.en_bbe: And let those who all their lives were in chains because of their fear of death, go free.

verses.en: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
verses.pt: Pois, evidentemente, não é aos anjos que ele ajuda, mas sim, ajuda à descendência de Abraão.
verses.en_web: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.
verses.en_bbe: For, truly, he does not take on the life of angels, but that of the seed of Abraham.

verses.en: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
verses.pt: Por isso era necessário que em tudo ele se tornasse semelhante aos irmãos, para ser misericordioso e fiel Sumo Sacerdote nas coisas relativas a Deus, para fazer sacrifício de perdão dos pecados do povo.
verses.en_web: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
verses.en_bbe: Because of this it was necessary for him to be made like his brothers in every way, so that he might be a high priest full of mercy and keeping faith in everything to do with God, making offerings for the sins of the people.

verses.en: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
verses.pt: Pois, naquilo em que ele mesmo sofreu ao ser tentado, ele pode socorrer aos que são tentados.
verses.en_web: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
verses.en_bbe: For having been put to the test himself, he is able to give help to others when they are tested.
